name: Member Return Criteria 1
definition: Defines the criteria used to report on a member.

NameIndicator.name: Name Indicator
NameIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the member name is requested.

MemberReturnAddressIndicator.name: Member Return Address Indicator
MemberReturnAddressIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the member return address is requested.

AccountIndicator.name: Account Indicator
AccountIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the member account is requested.

TypeIndicator.name: Type Indicator
TypeIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the member type is requested.

StatusIndicator.name: Status Indicator
StatusIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the member status is requested.

ContactReferenceIndicator.name: Contact Reference Indicator
ContactReferenceIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the contact references are requested.

CommunicationAddressIndicator.name: Communication Address Indicator
CommunicationAddressIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the communication addresses are requested.
